description:
In this role, you will be the focal point of defining next-gen architecture for Apple Vision products. The position allows you to work on wide range of topics including prototyping, hardware & silicon definition, software & algorithm development, hands-on characterization, concept demo to executives.

Description
Compare and scope display and optics technologies, analyze the trade-offs between performance, manufacturability and cost.

Define architecture for new display technologies with understanding of system requirement, display & optical behavior, human perception.

Define detailed specs including the display panel, driving ASICs, software/firmware algorithms and test/calibration procedure.

Promote innovation and new technology to improve Apple's display performance and user experience.

Minimum qualifications
BS and a minimum of 10 years relevant industry experience

Experience in the following areas: display backplane design, display pipeline, image processing, digital single processing, and/OR display architecture electrical and optical modeling.

Preferred qualifications
Bachelor's degree minimum in Electrical engineering or related field with 3 years of relevant proven experience

Good communication and leadership skills, with experience collaborating efficiently across internal teams and vendors teams. 

Capability in theoretical analysis, as well as system characterization and modeling.

Hands-on experimental ability with prototyping experience.

Experiences in following area is a plus: optics, device physics, or machine learning.
